family: R12-E EXPLOIT: percentile-gate (R11-B leg) x majority/confirmed strong bases (generalization test, local only)
hypothesis: R11-B percentile-gate rescued v33 (-5.9% -> +87%/1.88%/mo) by replacing the fixed 0.3 absolute threshold with a causal validation-percentile (top-decile-style) cutoff. Test whether this leg GENERALIZES to the strong ensemble bases (majority/confirmed) or is v33-specific.

base.base_note: Frozen v15 selection (never refit, never re-vote). Controls reuse these files bit-identical; pctgate branches are strict causal subsets.

score_column_finding.expected_net_percent: EXISTS: majority 50 unique (min 0.311, p50 0.593, p90 1.628, max 2.635); confirmed 43 unique (min 0.311, p50 0.683, max 2.635). Semantics: iso4 choose() calibrated expected net (percent) for the chosen candidate - the same score that passed the 0.3 absolute gate at selection time. Gating stricter on it is legitimate (no invented scores).

score_column_finding.decision: Score column exists -> build validation-top-decile-equivalent gate. t050-style fixed-gate fallback NOT needed (documented as not-triggered).

gate_rule.name: expanding-p90-subset
gate_rule.analog: v33cal v33-iso-topdec (per-fold t_f = 90th percentile of eligible history best-calibrated), adapted to frozen selection: threshold from the score distribution's own past upper tail.
exact_rule: Sort each base's frozen signals by signal_time ascending (already chronological).
For signal i (0-indexed): history_i = expected_net_percent of ALL base signals j < i (strictly past, kept-or-dropped: full past selected distribution, analog of v33cal eligible history).
Warmup: if len(history_i) < 10 -> WAIT (drop signal i; threshold undefined). min_history = 10, pre-specified.
threshold_i = 90th percentile of history_i (numpy quantile, linear interpolation). quantile = 0.9, pre-specified.
Keep signal i iff expected_net_percent_i >= threshold_i AND ohlc_fill_score_i >= 0.25 (base policy fill floor retained).
All comparisons use strictly-past data only (causal past-only). No refit, no future.
gate_rule.limitation_disclosed: Subset filter on frozen selection: rows suppressed by the ORIGINAL v15 frequency loop (monthly cap 4 + 5d cooldown) cannot re-enter, so a full decision-level re-run with the higher threshold could emit replacement signals. Fills here are a LOWER BOUND vs a full re-run. This is a documented limitation, not a causal violation (no future data used).

branch_specs.majority_control_1x: frozen majority signals, leverage 1.0. Must reproduce v15 majority_1x normal within 1e-9/exact or STOP.
branch_specs.majority_control_dd_guard: frozen majority signals, dd_guard sizing (guard from MY majority-control equity).
branch_specs.majority_pctgate_dd_guard: expanding-p90 subset of majority, dd_guard sizing.
branch_specs.confirmed_control_1x: frozen confirmed signals, leverage 1.0. Must reproduce v15 confirmed_1x normal within 1e-9/exact or STOP.
branch_specs.confirmed_pctgate_dd_guard: expanding-p90 subset of confirmed, dd_guard sizing.

dd_guard.reference: MY majority_control_1x normal trades recomputed in THIS run (not v15 files): equity sampled at trade exit_time/equity_after, seed level 100.0.
dd_guard.formula: At each branch signal time ts: past = exits strictly before ts (1-microsecond cutoff, past-only); curve = concat(seed 100.0, past); peak = trailing max; lev = 0.5 if level/peak < 0.9 else 1.0. Applied at each branch's OWN signal times (v15 convention).
dd_guard.execution: ExecutionConfig(leverage=0.25, max_leverage=1.0) with per-signal leverage column 0.5/1.0 (v15 exec_for convention, disclosed).

monthly_formula: ratio=final_equity/100; duration_years=(complete_evaluation_until - folds[0][0])/(365.2425*86400) per configs/swing_v15_continuous_folds.json; monthly_geometric_net=ratio^(1/(12*duration_years))-1; annual=ratio^(1/duration_years)-1
